scenario: multi-factor authentication being enforced, enroll your device through the link
subject: Verify Your Multi-Factor Authentication
body:
Dear [Student Name],

We hope this message finds you well. 

We are reaching out because we have detected some unusual activity on your IIT Hyderabad account. To ensure the security of your account, we are required to enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) immediately. 

You must complete the verification process by clicking the link below within the next 12 hours to avoid your account being locked. 

[https://portal.training.invalid/verify]

Failure to do so will result in your account being restricted.

Sincerely,

IIT Hyderabad IT Security Team

Please do not reply to this email as it is not monitored. For assistance, contact IT support at support@training.invalid.
